observations: Two solar panels with silver aluminum frames, monocrystalline-looking cells, standing outdoors leaning against a wall.
Grass and part of a motorcycle wheel visible in background, suggesting an outdoor compound setting.
A faint watermark reading 'IZUTECH SOLAR ENERGY' is overlaid on the image itself (added by seller/app), not a manufacturer nameplate on the panel.
No wattage rating, brand name, or model sticker is legible on either panel.
No close-up of the junction box, cables, or rear label is provided.

risks.risk: Wattage/capacity of the panels is unknown, which is the primary price driver for solar panels.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate/sticker showing rated wattage, voltage, and current.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; treated as missing critical spec

risks.risk: Panels may be used/refurbished with reduced output rather than new.
risks.proof: Photo or video of a multimeter/clamp meter reading open-circuit voltage and short-circuit current under sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unverified output, i.e. worst case functioning

risks.risk: Hidden micro-cracks, delamination, or hotspots not visible at this distance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each cell surface and frame corners, plus a shot of the junction box and cable condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume possible defects

risks.risk: Frame or glass damage from handling/transport not visible in the wide shot.
risks.proof: Full-frontal and side-angle photos showing frame edges and glass corners.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified, worst case minor damage assumed

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the rated wattage/specification label on the back of each panel.
Video showing a multimeter test of voltage/current output in sunlight.
Close-up shots of cell surfaces, frame corners, and junction box for damage check.
Photo of both panels laid flat, full view, for condition and matching pair confirmation.
response.reason: The wattage rating, which sets the price for solar panels, is not legible in the single available photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be established without a nameplate shot.
